docs.title: Annual leave

docs.rule: Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. New joiners receive a prorated allocation. The employee balance tool is the source for remaining days, not this annual entitlement.

docs.text:
A report should describe the issue, timing and desired follow-up without unnecessary sensitive personal details. The assistant can draft a general referral but is not an investigation intake system.

Scope and responsibility
This is a fictional conduct policy for the HR assistant demonstration. It applies to the mock employees in the supplied dataset. The employee initiates the request, the manager reviews operational impact, and HR or the relevant specialist confirms exceptions.

Procedure
Read this rule before making a request. Confirm the relevant employee record and provide only the facts needed for review. Where a rule depends on a balance, role, amount or document, verify that fact through the appropriate tool or responsible owner. If a fact is missing, request clarification.

Control and escalation
Keep policy evidence with the response using this page and section identifier. No assistant response grants approval, updates an official personnel record or commits funds. Route uncertain or exceptional cases to the accountable reviewer. A saved ticket documents a request only.

Example and review
An employee asks about reporting. The assistant retrieves this section, states the applicable rule and identifies missing information before preparing any follow-up. The reviewer checks the request against the cited version. HR owns changes to this demonstration rule; the effective date and version identify the material used.

docs.rule: Use individual approved accounts and multifactor authentication. Never share passwords, tokens or recovery codes. Access must be limited to the business need and reviewed when roles change.
